rows.name: I see... So my father, he...

rows.label: tlk43400441_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Now that I've married an Invidian,
I can't easily return to Gula...

rows.label: tlk43400441_02_msg0003
rows.name:
But I want to find a way to visit
that house soon.

rows.label: tlk43400441_02_msg0004
rows.name:
He must have entrusted those
golden bracers to you because
he knew he hadn't long left.
